description:
Test-only siblings of JMAP-sc1b.53. Same anti-pattern (clones JSON subtree before from_value), but inside #[cfg(test)] mod test_support (in-memory mock backend used by inline tests).

Sites:
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/lib.rs:372
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/lib.rs:383

Fix: serde_json::from_value::<O>(v.clone()) → O::deserialize(v) (need 'use serde::Deserialize' inside that test_support module, or qualified path).

Why P4: test-only code path; correctness unaffected; allocation cost is paid only by inline tests.

Bead split out of JMAP-sc1b.53 to keep that production-scope bead clean. Likely also worth checking if other extension-server test_support modules have the same pattern (chat, tasks, etc.).
